content: Anatumi Banya Ikinyingi Keta Pii Leya
Wambo dokopa Anatumi namwana akali kyawa dupwa banya poropeta akali dupwa keta pii lamaipa piya.
Epapu yuu gii repetale lumwa pira ingyapyamopa banya Ikinyingi keta pii langiya. Anatumi Ikinyingi keta yake yuupi wasapala karo dupwa peparae banyaŋa lapala baa maira ingilyamoko.

Ikinyingi doko Anatu peparae isa komba pyapala Rakangena yanga paupau lenge doko neta ranyi peenge. Banya pii porainya renge paleta dokome yuu muu dupwa peparae renge kuiyuo minyaro karenge. Baa isa wambunya koo dupwana pyuo elya pyuo nyepala yake pandana mupwa Anatu dokona kingi rolaerename pao peteya.
Yesunya Kingi Doko Kamame Ketae Ingyuo Palamo
Ikinyingi akali doko aŋala dupwa pipya baa ketae ingyuo rombo palyiyamopa banya kingi maiyamo doko dolomana kingi dupwa pipya manda manja naya.

content.text: Emba nambana ikinyingiŋi
epapu dakepa nambame embena Rakange ingyuo karoŋo,

content: lamaiyase? Dee Anatumi aŋala dupwana mende kando,

content.text: Aŋala dokona namba Rakange ingyuo kararo
baa nambana ikinyingi ingyuo pelyamo,

content: Anatu baame banya Ikinyingi mupwa doko isa panda repetale mapanyi peeyalana karo dokopa dopa pyuo leya.

content.text: Nambana aŋala peparaeme
banya kingi lao mona kando pisarami.

content: Baa aŋala dupwa suu pyao dopa leya.

content.text: Nambana aŋala dupwa porambaiye dopale ingyuo pena lao
kendemande dupwa yulu poo rele lao pinya lao mairu,

content: Dopa pyuo leyamopape Ikinyingi kando dopa leya.

content.text: Emba Anatuŋu, peparae isa karalu karare lyakande
rolaena renge palyuo embena wambu dupwa rolae dokome iso karenge.
Emba yulu rolae dupwa rae maipala
koo dupwa epekanda nao karene.
Dopa pyuo pipinyipa embena Anatu baame
emba mamba wele kiso kiŋi inginyi pyambuyamopa
rae maiyuo iso karalu karare.
Doloma embapa manda manja nara.

content: Dee pii mende konda pyuo leya doko,

content.text: Kamongo embame kanda soo dokopa
yuu muu dupwa peparae wasii.
Rangena kingi dokome yake doko wasiipya.
Wasiinyi dupwa mee ingyuo rali piramopape
emba yapo karalu karare.
Komau wambarae dupwa kwao penge
doko suu pyao bange peparae kwaoko para.
Komau kwaelyamo dokopa nembapala enenge nyingi
doko suu pyao yake yuupi
embame alowa pyuo enenge ingyare.
Dopa pyuo pirinyipape
embako ema napala mee karalu karare.
Emba epapala nambana kingi rolaerename pisarinyipa
nambame embena nyisu petenge dupwa
Anamasi minyapala emba keta jeronopa
mee kalya naro karare,

content: Yulu dokore aŋala dupwa keta mai naya. Nakama Anatunya kendemande imambu karaminyi dokona baame wambu yake panda parami dupwa nyisala pena lao mapanyi peenge.
